svg.text: Plate 8 mm, 340 x 400 mm (400 across the frame).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four slots 14 mm wide, 60 mm long, along the frame,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: over the crossbars 680 and 920 mm from the joint end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 40 mm in from the front edge and 40 mm from the back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M12 bolts through the slots into the crossbars (drill

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the crossbars through the slot middles).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Engine holes: mark from the engine's own base, so the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shaft sits 150 mm above the plate, crankshaft toward

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the belt side, square to the frame.
